title: J. Devn Cornish
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a Youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Guatemala/El Salvador Mission
Married Elaine Simmons 1973, Manti Utah Temple; Six children
BS and MD from Johns Hopkins University
Medical Doctor in newborn intensive care; Professor of Pediatrics and Vice-Chair of Pediatrics at Emory University School of Medicine
Elders Quorum President, Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President, Area Seventy
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2011 - present
